title: Remove the unconsumed frame-recorder wrapper and narrow three self-test telemetry conveniences
description: Outcome: FrameRecorder and its SystemClock/injected-clock convenience surface leave compiled production because no current runtime, benchmark, external fixture or protected caller uses this owner. The three test-only telemetry convenience methods remain available only to their existing unit-test module. Actual FrameTelemetry/SessionSummary schema, runtime/benchmark measurements, LatencyBucket assertions and collector behavior remain intact. No sampling, timestamp, replay, calibration policy or new test API is added.
design:
hud-bstmy.3 authorizes deleting production code without a current production caller. docs/scope.md T8 and Working rules require deleting rather than generalizing and preserving every invariant contract; docs/vision.md current-user/useful-test lessons and docs/invariants.md are current authority. Generation2 hud-bstmy.3.10 evidence at 8f61ab81dc6aab44229f5eff9ed2eb5be45d8261 supersedes bare live labels from generation1/G3. Re-read current definitions and all callers; line numbers are navigation, not permission to delete a new consumer.

Protected T7 boundary: never edit crates/tze_hud_projection/**, runtime/src/portal_projection_driver.rs, runtime/src/windowed/portal.rs, input/src/{composer_draft,portal_resize}.rs, config/src/portal_tokens.rs, mcp/src/portal_op.rs or tests/integration/text_stream_portal_*.rs; retain all public items they actually import. Retain live types, fields and required members. A protected type import does not justify deleting the type to remove an uncalled member; review member-specific receivers/static aliases independently, and retain/report any newly found protected member call.

Exact surface at audited8f61: telemetry/src/collector.rs:66 FrameRecorder, ::new:72, ::new_with_clock:79, ::begin_frame:89 and Default:97, its dead clock imports, doc example:54-64, and telemetry/src/lib.rs:15 reexport. Current calls are only collector.rs:111/113/119/126/127 inside its own two helper tests; no production/benchmark/external/protected call or method alias exists. SceneGraph::new_with_clock is an unrelated owner. Remove this wrapper and its two nearest helper-only attributed tests (test_frame_recorder_stamps_timestamp and test_frame_recorder_default_uses_system_clock), plus its own doctest. Do not recreate these implementation tests under new names.

Test-owned compiled methods: telemetry/src/record.rs:583 SessionSummary::to_json (only own existing serialization/schema tests at616/653/732/858/1072); validation.rs:402 ValidationReport::to_json (own report_serializes_to_json:611); validation.rs:90 HardwareFactors::cpu_only (own partial-calibration tests at433/449/487/599). Narrow using existing cfg(test)/module privacy; no new Cargo feature/helper crate. Preserve all those scenario/test bodies and serialization assertions. SceneSnapshot/McpError/operator-status to_json and benchmark Args.cpu_only are unrelated live owners and stay. Benchmark serializes its real report with serde_json, not these wrapper calls.

Keep telemetry/src/collector.rs:15/23/31/36 TelemetryCollector::{new,record,summary,records}; FrameTelemetry::new:record.rs202 and every serialized field including timestamp_us. Production frames construct FrameTelemetry::new directly; current timestamp_us defaults to0, so removing a dead producer is not authority to delete the field or claim timestamp population. Update record.rs:28 stale producer comment to describe the actual constructor behavior without a new sampling promise. Keep actual stage/sample vectors, record_frame_correctness, frame/render ordering, LatencyBucket window/percentiles/empty-sample error, HardwareFactors::new/uncalibrated/Default, ValidationReport::run, and benchmark/runtime consumers.

Failure/concurrency/replay/compatibility: preserve JSON field names/defaults and partial/uncalibrated/NoSamples/fail verdict cases; actual measured vector counts and p99/assert_p99_under semantics remain. Keep TZE_HUD_PERF_ASSERT policy/test_budget slack. The wrapper owns no live retry/replay/persisted state. Preserve .1.12 per-binary GPU init guards and all external multi-agent/vertical-slice sample, namespace, lifecycle, render and budget assertions. Do not change resource fields, clocks/enabler packets, WorkCounts/.5.3/.5.7, protocol gaps, T7, owner5.6 or8.6 posture.

Docs impact: update only affected existing API/reexport/record comments and PR explanation; no docs/spec/posture amendment or standalone page. Tests expected +0 ~0 -2 attributed helper tests, with one dead wrapper doctest removed separately; existing serialization/calibration/latency behavior tests preserved. Cohesion: one telemetry production API diet outcome, not separate feature work. Rollback is this scoped commit.

Verification: repeat owner-qualified searches across all tracked app/crates/examples/tests/nested benches, target-cfg and T7 paths after syncing main. All named invariants (current78 mentions/72 unique) must resolve by final::name plus test attribute. Use existing telemetry unit suite including test_latency_bucket_percentiles, test_session_summary_serialization, test_session_summary_record_frame_correctness_accumulates_violations, report_serializes_to_json and partial/no-samples cases; existing integration/multi_agent and vertical_slice budget tests. Run just fmt, cargo check --workspace, workspace all-targets clippy -D warnings and one normal just ci at final source; existing Windows-GNU/WindowsCI compatibility or explicit tool limitation. No new structural or serializer scan gate.

Use a coordinator-leased existing warm Cargo target, jobs1, PROTOC=/usr/bin/protoc3.21.12, the actual just lvp ICD (currently /usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/lvp_icd.json), HEADLESS_FORCE_SOFTWARE=1 and TZE_HUD_REQUIRE_GPU=1. Run default test parallelism. No wiped/shared foreign target, broad duplicated gates or skipped GPU proof. Record exact execution source, command, environment, whole log SHA, failed/skip line indexes and source after.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Whole-root owner/receiver/reexport/T7 inventory verifies the exact unused FrameRecorder owner and no new current user; wrapper/imports/reexport/two helper tests/doctest removed. New consumers are retained with exact conflict evidence.
2. The three exact self-test convenience methods are absent from compiled default production but continue to serve their existing unit tests; no new feature/accessor/helper crate and no unrelated same-name narrowing.
3. All actual frame/summary fields and runtime/benchmark telemetry, JSON schema/defaults, real latency vectors/percentiles/empty handling/calibration verdicts, .1.12 admission guards and external fixture assertions remain. timestamp_us remains unchanged, not silently dropped or invented as sampled.
4. Existing API/comment references match delivered behavior; no standalone docs/spec/posture change. Tests +0 ~0 -2 with only the two named helper tests removed (one wrapper doctest separately).
5. Exact-head existing telemetry/fixture behavior, fmt/workspace check/all-targets clippy/full normal just ci and Windows compatibility receipts pass; whole SHA and failures/skips indexed. No mirrored/new test species.
non_goals: No enabler/protocol/WorkCounts sibling repair or owner posture
verification_gate_species: Existing telemetry/serialization/latency and current integration/vertical-slice behavior gates; structural qualified source proof.
docs_impact: Existing affected API/reexport/record comments and PR evidence only.
